name: Telamon Ardavanis
description: Telamon leads partnerships and scouting at Edge City, a 501(c)(3) society incubator that runs month-long popup villages. So far that is 12 villages, across 5 continents, 12,500+ participants from 100+ countries, 500+ startups and projects, 300+ kids, and $2.5M+ raised in grants. Collaborators include Notion, Cursor, Ethereum Foundation, Protocol Labs, Replit,  and the Mercatus Center at George Mason.
